plan.title: Bug fix
plan.why: Remove a reproducible defect with a regression test and a reviewable fix.
plan.what:
## Scope

- State the failing behavior and the expected behavior.
- List the affected surfaces and the non-goals.

## Commit strategy

- Reproduce, fix, and guard with a regression test in separate green commits.

milestones.title: Fix the defect
milestones.desc: As a user, I want the defect removed, so that the expected behavior holds. Add inputs and prerequisites.

tasks.title: Reproduce the defect
tasks.desc:
Approach: add a failing test or a deterministic reproduction.

Commit: reproduction slice.

Verify: the reproduction fails for the expected reason.

tasks.title: Fix the defect
tasks.desc:
Approach: name the root cause and the smallest safe change.

Commit: fix slice.

Verify: the reproduction passes and the relevant suite stays green.

tasks.title: Guard the fix with a regression test
tasks.desc:
Approach: keep the reproduction as a permanent regression test.

Commit: regression slice.

Verify: the regression test fails without the fix.

tasks.title: Refactor the touched code
tasks.desc:
Approach: leave the fix area cleaner without changing behavior.

Commit: refactor slice.

Verify: the full test suite passes.

tasks.title: Update the documentation
tasks.desc:
Approach: record the corrected behavior where users will look.

Commit: docs slice.

Verify: links and examples resolve.
